optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Reliability
professionalSummary: Senior Technical Program Manager with over three years of senior-level program management experience at Vantor Data Cloud, leading large cross‑team initiatives and maintaining integrated plans and dependency maps.
experienceHighlights: Led the second‑region expansion program across nine engineering teams, managing an integrated plan and cross‑team dependency map in the planning tool (src_0316b17ec310).
Chaired the weekly program review with engineering managers, tracking risks with owners and closure dates in the RAID register (src_96f98f629107).
Sent fortnightly status reports to the VP of Engineering, detailing milestone status, top risks and leadership decisions (src_a393ae827c75).
Coordinated the migration of the build system to a new CI service across four teams (src_a502bd5edbe6).
Participated in planning the annual failover exercise, collecting runbooks and booking test windows (src_8eedce0ed7ee).
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised dependency map and milestone plan from the second‑region expansion program, illustrating nine teams, critical‑path dependencies, slipped milestones and decisions recorded at the program review (src_7b32d726aa59).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, HR verification note, and reference check confirm the candidate’s senior‑level program management experience, cross‑team program leadership, weekly review facilitation, status reporting to engineering leadership, and involvement in disaster‑recovery planning. No evidence is provided for production‑level disaster‑recovery test execution or for program leadership beyond the documented roles.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit based on evidence and gaps.

role.roleTitle: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Reliability

evidence.text: The promotion from Technical Program Manager to Senior Technical Program Manager on 1 March 2023 was checked against the promotion letter and the payroll record supplied by Vantor Data Cloud; the senior level was held until August 2026, three years and six months in all.
evidence.notes: Direct HR verification of senior level duration.

evidence.text: ran the second-region expansion program across nine engineering teams, keeping the integrated plan and the cross-team dependency map in the planning tool.
evidence.notes: Explicit mention of nine teams and integrated plan.

evidence.text: the engineering director at Vantor confirmed in writing that the candidate ran the second-region expansion program across nine teams and chaired its weekly program review.
Chaired the Tuesday program review with the engineering managers, tracking each risk with an owner and a closure date in the program's RAID register.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of weekly review and risk tracking.

evidence.text: Sent a fortnightly status report to the VP of Engineering with milestone status, top risks and the decisions needed from leadership.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of status reporting to VP.

evidence.text: Took part in planning the annual failover exercise, collecting runbooks from the service teams and booking the test windows.
evidence.notes: Evidence of planning but not execution of disaster‑recovery tests.
